layer_3_action.subject: A sun-drenched Early Cretaceous tropical lagoon margin.
features: White carbonate sand beaches meeting shallow turquoise water.
Scattered calcareous concretions and limestone outcrops along the shore.
Lush clusters of Brachyphyllum conifers and early water lilies near the margins.
Large predatory Calamopleurus and armored Vinctifer fish visible in the clear shallows.
Araripemys turtles resting on iron-oxide red mudbanks.
layer_3_action.action: A vibrant, high-key tropical scene with sharp, short shadows. The atmosphere is clear and saturated, emphasizing the terracotta and golden ochre earth tones. No grass.

visuals.ground: Fine white sand and variegated reddish-brown mudstone rich in iron-oxide. No grass.
visuals.water: Crystal clear, shallow turquoise lagoon water over a white carbonate silt floor.
visuals.sky: Bright tropical blue with high-key saturation and a slight hazy glow on the horizon.
